A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same CrispEdit research work. All 26 pages, including Appendices A–G, are readable and support comparison of text, equations, figures and tables.

before.justification: v1 reports original image-classification and LLM-editing experiments in Section 4, with additional numerical results and qualitative examples in the appendices.

after.justification: v2 reports the same original classification and LLM-editing experiments, including benchmark results, ablations and qualitative examples in Section 4 and the appendices.

M1.justification: The CrispEdit and CrispEdit-Seq procedures are identical, including the Bregman constraint, K-FAC approximation, matrix-free projection and sequential updates in Algorithms 1–2.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same MNIST/Fashion-MNIST, ZsRE, CounterFact, WikiBigEdit and Wikipedia data, five base-capability benchmarks, and batch and sequential editing scenarios.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in Figure 3 and Tables 1 and 3–5, including the respective comparisons with MEMIT, AlphaEdit, Adam-NSCL, LocBF-FT, UltraEdit, MEND, FT and LoRA.

E3.justification: Section 4 and Appendix E retain identical model configurations, sample counts, metrics, WILD and teacher-forcing evaluations, prompting procedures and training settings.

E4.justification: The curvature comparison, threshold and capability-data sweeps, edit-scaling analysis, prompt-masking ablation, sequential-retention analysis and Appendix F case studies are unchanged.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests for the experiments. Statistical and uncertainty reporting is unchanged.

E6.justification: All numerical results, plotted findings and qualitative examples match. For example, Table 1 reports identical CrispEdit ZsRE scores with QA context: 80.5 reliability and 69.0 generalization.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, assumptions, derivations and Propositions 1–3 are identical, including the proofs in Appendices B–D.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain identical claims about scalable curvature-based editing, capability preservation, relationships to existing editors and computational efficiency.

C2.justification: Interpretations of the edit–preservation trade-off, robustness and sequential retention are unchanged. Appendix E retains the same uncertainty about why prompt masking harms K-FAC performance.

D1.justification: Appendix E, Table 2, hardware and runtime disclosures, and code and project access information are identical. The arXiv version-link update does not change reproducibility resources.

R1.justification: Section 5, the reference list and discussions positioning CrispEdit relative to prior editing and continual-learning methods are identical.

P1.justification: Only the first-page marginal arXiv stamp changes from v1 dated 17 February 2026 to v2 dated 1 May 2026. The manuscript prose, headings and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–8 and Tables 1–8 retain identical content, captions, formatting and placement. Rendered pages match throughout except for the marginal version/date text recorded under P1.

improvement.justification: The main text and appendices preserve identical scientific content, evidence, explanations and presentation. The sole visible revision is the administrative arXiv version/date stamp, which makes no meaningful difference to overall paper quality.
